effects.label: Action
effects.text: Place this card beneath one card in your Treasury. At the start of your next turn, after the Capture step and income, return that Treasury card to your Hand and gain Capital equal to its value, then put this card in your Discard Pile. If you lose a battle before then, put both cards in your Discard Pile instead. If the chosen card leaves Treasury first, put this card in your Discard Pile.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: In the Aftermath, if you won, choose one other card you controlled in this battle that would go to a Discard Pile or Graveyard. Place that card face up in your Treasury instead.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Make one Deed you own unowned. Gain Capital equal to the number of Deeds you owned before doing so. After this Action resolves, you may take one additional Action during this phase.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: Before dice are rolled, you may make one Deed you own unowned to gain Capital equal to the number of Deeds you owned before doing so, then you may immediately Subsidize.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Choose one card in your Treasury and put it in your Discard Pile. Gain Capital equal to its value, then you may immediately buy or buy out one Deed.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: Before dice are rolled, you may put one card from your Treasury in your Discard Pile to gain Capital equal to its value, then you may immediately Subsidize.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card, binding another card from your Hand or Treasury face up beneath it as collateral. Gain Capital equal to the bound card's value +2. Then you may take one additional Action this phase.

effects.label: Asset
effects.text:
At the start of your next turn, after Capture and income, choose:

- Repay — Pay Capital equal to the bound card's value +3. Return it to your Hand; put this card in your Discard Pile.
- Default — Put both cards in your Graveyard.

If this Asset leaves play while it has a bound card, Default.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: Before dice are rolled, you may bind another card from your Hand or Treasury face up beneath this card as collateral. If you do, gain Capital equal to its value and may Subsidize. In the Aftermath: win — return the bound card to your Hand; otherwise — put both cards in your Graveyard.

effects.label: Asset
effects.text: The first time each turn your opponent advances onto a Territory whose Deed you own, they choose one: discard one card from Hand; or you gain 2 Capital.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: If this battle takes place on a Territory whose Deed you own, your opponent chooses one: discard one card from Hand; or you gain 3 Capital in the Aftermath.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Choose one Territory you neither control nor occupy. Place this card face up beside it. At the start of your next turn, if you occupy or control that Territory, gain 2 Capital and put this card in your Discard Pile. Otherwise, put this card in your Graveyard.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: If you initiated this battle, you may spend 1 Capital. If you win after doing so, gain 2 Capital in the Aftermath. If the battle ends without you winning, put this card in your Graveyard.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: In the Aftermath of a battle you lost after using Subsidize, you may discard this card to gain Capital equal to the bonus you purchased.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: In the Aftermath, if you lost and used Subsidize, gain Capital equal to the bonus you purchased.
